title: Maps from a ring of finite type over Z into a filtered colimit of rings factor through a stage
statement: Let $I$ be a small filtered category, $i\mapsto A_i$ a functor from $I$ to commutative rings with colimit $A=\varinjlim_IA_i$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], coprojections $\iota_i:A_i\to A$ and transition maps $A(u):A_i\to A_j$ for $u:i\to j$. Let $R_0$ be a commutative ring of finite type over $\mathbf Z$ (generated as a ring by finitely many elements) and $h:R_0\to A$ a ring map. Then (1) there are $i\in I$ and a ring map $g:R_0\to A_i$ with $\iota_i\circ g=h$; (2) if $g:R_0\to A_i$ and $g':R_0\to A_{i'}$ satisfy $\iota_i\circ g=\iota_{i'}\circ g'$, there are $k$ and $u:i\to k$, $u':i'\to k$ with $A(u)\circ g=A(u')\circ g'$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 00QO (lemma-characterize-finite-presentation), (1) implies (2), with base ring $\mathbf Z$ (a ring of finite type over the noetherian ring $\mathbf Z$ is of finite presentation over $\mathbf Z$: $R_0=\mathbf Z[x_1,\dots,x_n]/(f_1,\dots,f_m)$ by the Hilbert basis theorem); stated there for directed systems, here for filtered index categories (Categories, Section Tag 04AX); used in the proof of Lemma Tag 00U2 (9)
